# Nyabag App

Nyabag at `https://app.nyabag.com` is the authenticated product app for saving, organizing, and rediscovering design references.

## Crawl Guidance

- This deployment is app-only.
- The root path `/` is the protected bookmarks dashboard.
- Product routes such as `/bookmarks/*`, `/canvas`, `/captures`, `/folders/*`, and `/profile` require authentication.
- `/login`, `/signup`, `/privacy`, and `/terms` are functional support routes, not marketing pages.
- Legacy `/app/*` URLs redirect to their root equivalents.
- Do not treat this deployment as a public marketing or editorial content site.
